decisions.reason: The original Example gives only a noise covariance, while F1 and step 2.1 require an additive independent Gaussian experiment. At rho=0, take independent standard normals T,Z1,Z2, theta=T, eta=(T/2+sqrt(3)Z1/2,Z2), and Y=(T,T)+eta. Although Cov(eta)=I2, the effective independent-noise model has loading (3/2,1) and residual covariance diag(3/4,1), so EIG=log(5)/2, contradicting log(3)/2. Added the full independent Gaussian model and corrected F1; the intended determinant formula is preserved.

The Example and F2 omit noise independence, making the asserted EIGs false for admissible parameter-dependent unit Gaussian noise. For independent standard normals T,Z, set theta=(T,0) and eta=T/2+sqrt(3)Z/2. Then Y=A_perp theta+eta has EIG=log(4/3)/2 and Y=A_parallel theta+eta has EIG=log(4)/2, from independent residual variance 3/4 and signal coefficients 1/2 and 3/2. Specified eta~N(0,1) independent of theta and Y=A theta+eta, and repaired F2.
